text:
```yaml
name: Check
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://just.systems/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions/rust@1802200111101111111111111111111111111111 # v1.10.0
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Run just check
        run: just check
```
